items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: And Basie of course and Gus Johnson.

ctx.x: I think Jimmy Lewis played bass.
Oh Jimmy Lewis, I beg your pardon, yeah Jimmy Lewis. And Basie of course and Gus Johnson. Yeah they played at the Champagne Supper Club here in San Francisco, small

group. So that’s what it did with us. The big bands, they had to reduce. Woody Herman was out with a small group. Buddy Rich was out with a quintet. In ’60, when we were in Chicago, he was playing in the room under our hotel. The Cloisters. We stayed at the Maryland Hotel. And they had a room called The Cloisters. Buddy Rich came in, Miles, he played at the Bird House but they stayed at the hotel.
